title: 横批
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：上、右、左。以连续换向牵制对手，最后用一记横批扫向目标。适用于长剑和短剑。
second_page: 横批以斩击为主，并辅以打击伤害。命中头部时攻击面部，命中其他部位时则集中伤害腹部。翻到这里，你已经开始练习横批。

en_us.title: Mittelhaw
en_us.first_page: Input: Up, Right, Left. Change direction repeatedly to occupy the opponent, then finish with a horizontal sweep. Usable with short swords and longswords.
en_us.second_page: Mittelhaw emphasizes slash damage with supporting strike damage. Head hits target the face; all other hits are focused on the abdomen.
